info.name: OpenRegister API: integration links and flows (T26)
info.description: Newman coverage for the object-link integration controllers (pollLinks, bookmarkLinks, shareLinks, flowLinks, photoLinks, collectiveLinks, xwikiLinks, cospendLinks, openProjectLinks, mapLinks), the lookups (companyLookup, personLookup), messageDispatch and the flow API (flow, flowPrincipal, flowDryRun, flowNodeRun). Every route gets its success or documented absent-service answer, an unknown-id case, invalid input where the method validates, and the non-admin and anonymous access answers, with a re-read after refused writes. The collection seeds its own data in `00 setup` (register, an open and an admin-only schema, one object in each, a non-admin user, a flow) and removes it in `99 teardown`; it depends on no other collection.

exec: // Each request authenticates on its own: drop the Nextcloud session cookie a
// previous request left in the jar, or the admin session would answer the
// non-admin and anonymous requests.
pm.cookies.jar().clear(pm.variables.replaceIn('{{base_url}}'), function () {});

item.name: 00 setup
item.description: Seeds a register with an open and an admin-only schema, one object in each, a non-admin user and a published-ready flow. Every id lands in a collection variable; 99 teardown removes them.

exec: const stamp = Date.now().toString(36) + Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e6).toString(36);
pm.collectionVariables.set('stamp', stamp);
pm.collectionVariables.set('user_id', 't26u' + stamp);
pm.collectionVariables.set('user_password', 'T26-' + stamp + '-Pw!x9');
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('principal types list user and group', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.results).to.include.members(['user', 'group']); pm.expect(json.total).to.eql(json.results.length); });
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('user created', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.ocs.meta.statuscode).to.eql(200); pm.expect(json.ocs.data.id).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('user_id')); });

pm.test('register created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.slug).to.eql('t26-links-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('stamp')); pm.collectionVariables.set('register_id', json.id); });

pm.test('schema created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.slug).to.eql('t26-open-' + pm.collectionVariables.get('stamp')); pm.collectionVariables.set('schema_id', json.id); });

pm.test('locked schema created with its authorization', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.authorization.read).to.eql(['admin']); pm.collectionVariables.set('locked_schema_id', json.id); });
pm.test('status is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('register holds both schemas', function () { const json = pm.response.json(); const ids = json.schemas.map(s => String(typeof s === 'object' ? s.id : s)); pm.expect(ids).to.include.members([String(pm.collectionVariables.get('schema_id')), String(pm.collectionVariables.get('locked_schema_id'))]); });

pm.test('object created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.name).to.eql('T26 open object'); pm.collectionVariables.set('object_id', json.id); });

pm.test('locked object created', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 201]); const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.name).to.eql('T26 locked object'); pm.collectionVariables.set('locked_object_id', json.id); });
